original_method: Prove common target identity, capture read-only NVMe inventory and slot/serial mapping, collect full command views and complete Web evidence within a bounded window, identify per-device versus aggregate semantics, normalize fields and compare to SPEC without resetting or writing storage or clearing logs.

Redact credentials and storage identifiers as required

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: One OOB `sensor get TEMP_NVME` can corroborate a named record but cannot prove its drive/slot identity, all four command views or Web parity; the fallback is incomplete.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Collect full IB/OOB lists and protected Web fields, joined to read-only NVMe inventory and the approved per-device/aggregate mapping.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All five views and source timing remain; grep-only/truncated evidence, generic clear and all storage mutations are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Join the sensor to slot/serial/model inventory or a documented aggregation set, then retain timestamped five-view fields and load context.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds storage-topology identity and aggregate semantics to the interface comparison.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A healthy aggregate can hide one hot drive, while a removed drive can make a missing per-device sensor legitimate.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BMC and drive-native SMART temperatures may measure different locations; do not assert equivalence unless the SPEC maps them.

project_override_considerations: Define populated devices, slot/serial mapping, whether TEMP_NVME is per-device or aggregate, sensor source, limits and time/load tolerance. No storage operation is authorized by this review.
expected_evidence: Read-only NVMe inventory and sensor mapping/aggregation definition
Complete decoded IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists
Protected Web evidence and page context

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently target NVMe temperature across five views. Mapping readiness, generic clear and DeepSeek incompleteness do not create competing intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Inventory, sensor mapping, access and SPEC are identifiable inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED if the generic sensor cannot be tied to a documented device set after obtaining them.

review_improvement: Adds the storage identity needed to distinguish a real drive thermal result from a plausible but unmapped generic sensor value.
independent_technical_reasoning: NVMe population is serviceable and can change independently of BMC sensor labels. A generic temperature may represent one controller, a slot proxy or a maximum across drives; therefore inventory and aggregation mapping must precede any limit comparison, while the review remains strictly read-only to storage.
